capability: Decode one captured Modbus RTU register response against an explicit typed CSV map.
user: Controls engineers reviewing an offline serial capture with a device register map.
pain: A CRC-valid byte sequence still needs explicit address context, byte order, scale and coverage evidence.
expected: Exit 0, with temperature -10, status 0 and pressure 12.5. All four captured registers are covered.
contract: ASCII hexadecimal RTU response, expected unit 1–247 and function 3 or 4, and mandatory zero-based --start supplied from the request. The response does not carry its start address: context is caller asserted. Validate length, even byte count and CRC16/MODBUS; CRC is not authentication. CSV columns exactly name,address,type,order,scale,offset. u16/i16 use AB or BA; u32/i32/f32 use ABCD/BADC/CDAB/DCBA. Byte-order labels describe wire order relative to canonical ABCD. Scale and offset use exact decimal arithmetic; finite binary32 values retain their exact binary value before scaling.
limits: One frame of 5–256 bytes and at most 125 registers; CSV 64 KiB and 125 rows. No overlapping mapped spans, serial ports, TCP, polling, device writes, request capture pairing, authentication or device-specific register semantics. Exceptions, unmapped words, map rows outside the response and nonfinite floats produce valid exit-1 evidence. Exact numeric representation is not a claim about sensor measurement precision.
acceptance: Verify known CRC vectors, all byte orders, signed values, binary32 scaling, complete map coverage, CRC failure and valid exception/nonfinite/out-of-range findings.
notes: libmodbus and Pymodbus provide full client/server protocol implementations. Modpoll already supports CSV-based device configuration. The broad modbus query also returned telemetry and energy platforms; these are broader integrations, while the focused modbus library query placed libmodbus first. No capability-absence claim or device reliability comparison is made.
alternatives: Use libmodbus/Pymodbus protocol code or Modpoll with appropriate device configuration.
overlap: No existing owned project decodes RTU response frames or typed Modbus register maps. General CSV validation and packet text tools do not provide this protocol contract.
